profile.purpose: Run two RFdiffusion candidates through two bounded optimization rounds with ESMFold2-Fast scoring.

published_predictor_deviations.reason: This profile removes the inherited esmfold2-predictor adapter and its screen and rescore stages. The full-mode deployment revision, model revision, and environment identity are unmeasured. This profile runs ESMFold2-Fast only.

This profile removes the inherited protenix-v2-predictor adapter and its screen and rescore stages. Protenix v2 has no measured runnable deployment for this package. This profile runs ESMFold2-Fast only.

model_likelihood.description: The designed-residue ProteinMPNN score, the mean negative log-likelihood the designer reports as score= on each FASTA header. The normalize-candidates stage copies it onto every candidate row as value.

filters.TODO_threshold_model_likelihood: filters.contracts[model_likelihood].threshold is 0.7 and no source supports it. The published protocol gives no model-likelihood threshold, as novelty_filter.py records. The only executed ProteinMPNN run in this campaign scored 36 of 36 candidates between 0.7088 and 1.0200, so a maximum of 0.7 rejects all of them. Set and record a threshold before a real run.

threshold_basis.maximum_clash_count: Project control measurement. The repaired positive control was observed with no clashes. That control record does not ship with this package. This is a maximum gate, so zero admits only zero observed clashes.
